items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I tell you, and Happy Goldstein, I got him in there. I told that fellow, let him in.

ctx.x: And the other officials. Oh, yeah. And the other officials. Oh, yeah.

And the other officials. Oh, yeah. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. And they kept him dear in the auditorial . That one day and he stood home at the house and this kept warming up on his horn all day. I tell you, and Happy Goldstein, I got him in there. I told that fellow, let him in. You know who was going in? He wanted to get in bed, Happy Goldstein. And he came in and they was playing one of the Saints go, and Happy came in and took him for the grand marshal. And Happy led the band on the stage.
What band was that? I remember that. See I was in the Navy then, I couldn't see it.
